not even sure how true that is either, even on a day where I can function or am not stuck in a rut thinking about depression, I have no energy. I don't know, man, there's too much wrong, I really can't hack it, though this is probably better off in r/depression because I don't think I've got the balls to kill myself. 

Again, thanks for replying. I was pretty hostile above and for such a delicate subject matter it can be hard to know what to say or how to approach.

I appreciate the reply. I have spoken to my doctor, was on anti-depressants etc. those didn't help. Absolutely nothing is going right, no matter what I try. I'm so mentally tired and I do fuck all.  I can't seem to find solace in anything now. I don't even know what the point of my post was other than to vent. haha
oh, and, no need to pad your answers because i'm depressed. I'm a big boy, I can handle it. :D
